I've got the itaste MVP v3.0 PRO (I think all v3's are called 'PRO'). It's a fantastic box with plenty of nice features, it's surprisingly ergonomic for a rectangle and fits in your hand very nicely. It can still charge from your PC with an included cable. It's a very solid all metal construction but has well vented batteries too (after about 32 puffs at 35w it was only just getting lukewarm). It usually lasts 3 - 4 days from full charge.
